6552145_e1cd39ad.text: The subiculum also provides feedback connections to earlier stages of the hippocampal circuit, with anatomical and electrophysiological evidence showing that subicular neurons provide excitatory synaptic input back to CA1 pyramidal cells (Xu et al., 2016).
